description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different DPR models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares six different DPR models: DPR w/o query (black, solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow, solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple, dashed line), DPR w/ random (blue, dashed line with circle markers), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, dashed line with circle markers). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.4 across the x-axis. The yellow line starts at around 33.0 at x=1, is not visible until x=4 where it is at approximately 33.2, and increases to around 35.0 at x=10. The green line starts at around 34.4 at x=1, drops to approximately 33.0 at x=2, and then increases to around 36.4 at x=10. The purple line starts at around 34.7 at x=1, decreases to approximately 34.6 at x=4, and then remains relatively steady, ending at around 34.6 at x=10. The blue line starts at around 34.7 at x=1, increases to approximately 35.3 at x=2, and then gradually decreases to around 35.2 at x=10. The red line starts at around 35.4 at x=1, increases to approximately 35.7 at x=4, and then remains relatively steady, ending at around 35.7 at x=10.
